scientific_integrity.limitations: Only symmetric Poisson switching, two coordinates, equal damping, positive shear, independent isotropic additive Brownian noise. No claim about almost-sure Lyapunov exponents or absence of infinite-variance invariant laws.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Conditional moment generator; invariant-sector factorization; cubic Routh–Hurwitz inequalities; Perron eigenmode at the sharp boundary; exact rational and finite ODE checks
scientific_integrity.statement: Exact first- and second-moment thresholds and finite-variance stationary covariance in the specified two-state, two-coordinate alternating directed-shear diffusion and critical correlation ratio

title: Exact moment-instability gap for alternating directed shear diffusion
